display_name: E01 Net OEM Warranty Burden & Supplier Leakage by Component

prompt.text: For each failure component, report our Realized Warranty Cost, 70% Recoverable Supplier Chargeback (requiring all replaced defective parts returned), Unrecovered Supplier Leakage, and Net OEM Warranty Burden.

golden_response.text: WITH parts_by_order AS (  SELECT service_order_id, LOGICAL_AND(defective_part_returned) AS all_defective_parts_returned   FROM `sa-demo-agentic.auto_aftersales_data.service_parts_usage`   GROUP BY service_order_id) SELECT w.failure_component, COUNTIF(w.claim_status = 'Approved') AS approved_claims, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN w.claim_status = 'Approved' THEN w.claim_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS realized_warranty_cost, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN w.claim_status = 'Approved' AND w.supplier_fault = TRUE AND COALESCE(p.all_defective_parts_returned, FALSE) = TRUE THEN w.claim_amount * 0.70 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS recoverable_supplier_chargeback, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN w.claim_status = 'Approved' AND w.supplier_fault = TRUE AND COALESCE(p.all_defective_parts_returned, FALSE) = FALSE THEN w.claim_amount * 0.70 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS unrecovered_supplier_leakage, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN w.claim_status = 'Approved' THEN w.claim_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN w.claim_status = 'Approved' AND w.supplier_fault = TRUE AND COALESCE(p.all_defective_parts_returned, FALSE) = TRUE THEN w.claim_amount * 0.70 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS net_oem_warranty_burden FROM `sa-demo-agentic.auto_aftersales_data.warranty_claims` w LEFT JOIN parts_by_order p USING (service_order_id) GROUP BY w.failure_component ORDER BY net_oem_warranty_burden DESC

display_name: E02 Realized Warranty Spend per Entitled Vehicle by Active Model

prompt.text: Across our 8 active vehicle models, what is the Active Warranty Entitled Fleet size, total Realized Warranty Cost, and Realized Warranty Cost per Entitled Vehicle?

golden_response.text: WITH entitled_fleet AS (  SELECT vin, model_id,   (warranty_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE() AND (ownership_status = 'Active' OR (ownership_status = 'Transferred' AND extended_warranty_purchased = TRUE))) AS is_entitled   FROM `sa-demo-agentic.auto_aftersales_data.vehicle_ownership`), approved_claims AS (  SELECT vin, SUM(claim_amount) AS approved_spend   FROM `sa-demo-agentic.auto_aftersales_data.warranty_claims`   WHERE claim_status = 'Approved' GROUP BY vin) SELECT vm.model_id, vm.model_name, vm.category, COUNTIF(ef.is_entitled) AS active_entitled_fleet, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(ac.approved_spend, 0)), 2) AS realized_warranty_spend, ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(COALESCE(ac.approved_spend, 0)), COUNTIF(ef.is_entitled)), 2) AS realized_warranty_cost_per_entitled_vehicle FROM `sa-demo-agentic.auto_sales_data.vehicle_models` vm INNER JOIN entitled_fleet ef ON vm.model_id = ef.model_id LEFT JOIN approved_claims ac ON ef.vin = ac.vin GROUP BY vm.model_id, vm.model_name, vm.category ORDER BY realized_warranty_spend DESC

display_name: E03 Dealership OEM Warranty Absorption & Unreturned Core Leakage

prompt.text: For our 8 active dealerships, show total OEM warranty-absorbed service cost (including covered Repair and Recall Service orders) and total Unrecovered Supplier Leakage from unreturned defective parts.

golden_response.text: WITH parts_by_order AS (  SELECT service_order_id, LOGICAL_AND(defective_part_returned) AS all_defective_parts_returned   FROM `sa-demo-agentic.auto_aftersales_data.service_parts_usage`   GROUP BY service_order_id), order_metrics AS (  SELECT so.dealership_id,   COUNTIF(so.is_warranty_covered) AS warranty_covered_orders,   ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN so.is_warranty_covered THEN so.total_cost - so.customer_paid_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS oem_absorbed_service_cost,   ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN w.claim_status = 'Approved' AND w.supplier_fault = TRUE AND COALESCE(p.all_defective_parts_returned, FALSE) = FALSE THEN w.claim_amount * 0.70 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS unrecovered_supplier_leakage   FROM `sa-demo-agentic.auto_aftersales_data.service_orders` so   LEFT JOIN `sa-demo-agentic.auto_aftersales_data.warranty_claims` w USING (service_order_id)   LEFT JOIN parts_by_order p USING (service_order_id)   GROUP BY so.dealership_id) SELECT d.dealership_id, d.dealership_name, d.region, d.state, om.warranty_covered_orders, om.oem_absorbed_service_cost, om.unrecovered_supplier_leakage FROM `sa-demo-agentic.auto_sales_data.dealerships` d INNER JOIN order_metrics om USING (dealership_id) ORDER BY om.unrecovered_supplier_leakage DESC

display_name: E04 Assembly Plant vs Component Source Plant Approved Warranty Cost

prompt.text: Across our 7 active manufacturing plants, compare Approved OEM assembly-fault warranty cost (by build_plant_name) against Approved supplier-fault warranty cost (by part_source_plant_name).

golden_response.text: WITH active_plants AS (  SELECT DISTINCT p.plant_id, p.plant_name, p.location, p.capacity   FROM `sa-demo-agentic.auto_manufacturing_data.plants` p   INNER JOIN `sa-demo-agentic.auto_manufacturing_data.assembly_line_status` als     ON p.plant_name = als.plant_name), assembly_claims AS (  SELECT build_plant_name AS plant_name,   COUNTIF(claim_status = 'Approved' AND supplier_fault = FALSE) AS approved_assembly_claims,   ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN claim_status = 'Approved' AND supplier_fault = FALSE THEN claim_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS assembly_fault_cost   FROM `sa-demo-agentic.auto_aftersales_data.warranty_claims` GROUP BY build_plant_name), component_claims AS (  SELECT part_source_plant_name AS plant_name,   COUNTIF(claim_status = 'Approved' AND supplier_fault = TRUE) AS approved_component_claims,   ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN claim_status = 'Approved' AND supplier_fault = TRUE THEN claim_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS component_fault_cost   FROM `sa-demo-agentic.auto_aftersales_data.warranty_claims` GROUP BY part_source_plant_name) SELECT ap.plant_id, ap.plant_name, ap.location, ap.capacity, COALESCE(ac.approved_assembly_claims, 0) AS approved_assembly_claims, COALESCE(ac.assembly_fault_cost, 0) AS assembly_fault_cost, COALESCE(cc.approved_component_claims, 0) AS approved_component_claims, COALESCE(cc.component_fault_cost, 0) AS component_fault_cost FROM active_plants ap LEFT JOIN assembly_claims ac USING (plant_name) LEFT JOIN component_claims cc USING (plant_name) ORDER BY assembly_fault_cost DESC
